frontmatter.name: mesh-android
frontmatter.description: Agent B. Builds the Android app (BLE L2CAP transport, foreground service, WebView shell, permissions) in app/ and the deploy/forward scripts, and tests on emulators and the three real phones. Use for anything under app/.

frontmatter.name: mesh-core
frontmatter.description: Agent A. Builds the protocol core (identity, codec, crypto, PoW, security pipeline, routing, sync, store) and the virtual-time simulator tests in core/. Use for anything under core/.

frontmatter.name: mesh-qa
frontmatter.description: Agent D. Writes extra adversarial tests, THREATS.md, DEMO.md and the Devpost text, and collects measured numbers. Use for docs/ and core/src/test/kotlin/mesh/redteam/.

frontmatter.name: mesh-ui
frontmatter.description: Agent C. Builds the plain web UI and its local server (uiserver/), the LAN transport (lan/), the desktop node (desktop/), run-3-desktop.sh and e2e.sh. Use for anything under uiserver/, lan/ or desktop/.

nodes.label: Agent C: UI, server, desktop. Owns `uiserver/`, `lan/`, `desktop/`, `scripts/run-3-desktop.sh`, `scripts/e2e.sh`
